text:
ajay: Heads-up — saw a ~45% day-over-day spike in cloud GPU spend for project 'playground-dev' during 03/18 00:00-06:00 UTC. Not tagged to any cost center. Can we reassign funds to cover this and avoid invoice surprises?

maria: Ugh. Can you paste the billing query + top-line numbers so we can route approvals?

ajay: Quick output from BQ — runs were a burst of ~300 preemptible A100 hours (short jobs).
```sql
project_id        | cost
playground-dev    | $18,386.22
ci-infra          | $1,120.50
analytics-sandbox | $420.11
```

liam: @ajay is playground-dev owned by platform or ML infra? I thought that was still under dev sandbox budget.

ajay: Platform owns infra for that project but it got used by a couple of ML experiments (unapproved colab-style runs). No cost-center tag on those instances.

billing-bot: ALERT: Unusual GPU spend detected — project=playground-dev amount=$18,386 window=6h rule=gt(10k). Ticket created: BILL-1709.

sarah: We should avoid moving things around last-minute, but I agree we need to cover the invoice or we'll hit the threshold and cause billing alerts. What's the ask? Emergency reallocation from contingency?

ajay: Short ask: approve one-time reallocation of up to $20k from "infra-contingency" to the sandbox cost center and require project owner tagging + backfill. Long term: limit preemptible quotas per project and add budget alert at $5k daily.

maria: I can approve an emergency reallocation now but need VP/CFO FYI for retro budget adjustments. @cecil — can you sign off on retro carve-out if we move $20k?

cecil: FYI noted. I approve emergency cover for $20k on the condition we get a post-mortem and owner assigned. Please include projected offset (where to pull funds) in the ticket.

liam: I'll own the post-mortem and add owner tags. Ajay, can you run the tag-backfill script and add a short runbook for enforced labels?

ajay: On it. Will run backfill now and push a tiny enforcement policy to terraform to add a deny rule for untagged GPU instances (soft deny + notify) — rollout in staging first.

maria: For the approval flow: I approved the $20k reallocation in our internal ledger (REF: AR-2026-03-18). Please add an expense note to BILL-1709 with the ledger ref and expected offset line items.

ajay: Added note to BILL-1709 and pushed a minimal budget alert rule: budget.gpu.playground-dev -> $5,000/day email to #billing and owner.

billing-bot: NOTE: Cost assignment updated: playground-dev tagged -> cost_center=platform_playground; invoice allocation pending until retro approval.

sarah: Thanks everyone. Action items: (1) Ajay — backfill tags + soft deny (2) Liam — post-mortem + owner assignment (3) Maria — finalize ledger entry + follow up with Cecil for retro carve-out.

cecil: Got it. Keep the finance channel updated. If post-mortem shows negligence, we'll discuss cost recovery policy. :eyes:

ajay: Will deliver post-mortem by EOD tomorrow. Realloc already executed so invoice won't trigger an alert. Thanks all :thumbsup:

maria: Marking this thread as resolved for now. Please reopen if anything else pops up.
